learning_outcomes.text: The students understand the concepts of the most common approaches in language processing.
The students have the ability to create high-quality programs using language understanding technologies.
The students can implement their own methods and defend them against competing approaches.
Programming exercises take place within the course. Students are also able to understand, critique, and complement programs from other students.

syllabus_topics: Text Classification: naive Bayes, Spam filtering, Speech recognition, logistic regression
Search engines: Ranking, Vector space model, PageRank
Outlook: Embeddings, current advances in NLP
teaching_methods: Discussion of scientific articles and current news
assessment_rules: The examination type is a written exam of 90 minutes. The weighting of the grade is 5/210.
